top_issues: Empty-state hero: total balance $0.00 with four $0.00 bucket chips and 'Instant: send up to $0.00' — the whole first screen communicates zero, no onboarding path beyond a muted one-liner
'1 px = $10 · auto' label near 'Move' is unexplained jargon on the main screen; nothing tells a new user what the absolute-scale bars mean
ACCOUNTS card shows 'H1 USDC —' with 'no tokens' in faint gray; relationship between H1, USDC and the buckets is opaque
Left rail has two visually identical list icons (3rd and 4th) with no labels — destination unclear
fixes: Add a first-run checklist card under the balance: '1. Get test funds 2. Open an account 3. Pay someone' with buttons
Label the rail icons or show tooltips; differentiate the two list glyphs
Explain '1 px = $10' inline: 'bar scale' with link to Settings

top_issues: QR is rendered as dark modules on cream — inverted contrast against the dark theme, reads as a pasted-in asset
'receive up to 0.00 instantly' inside the amount field is easy to miss and phrased as a limit without explaining why it is zero
Raw 64-char entity ID in monospace fills two lines with no copy affordance next to it

fixes: Render QR in dark-on-light card consistent with theme, or white modules on the indigo surface with quiet zone
Add a copy button beside the entity ID; truncate with reveal
Promote 'Open H1' to a button

top_issues: Literal error string 'MARKET_WIRE_JSON_REQUIRED' printed in the order book panel — a raw internal error shown to users; kills trust instantly
Order book is otherwise empty: no price levels, no spread, no last price; 'syncing' dot only
'You receive 0.00' stays at 0.00 with 100 USDC entered and no rate, no fee, no minimum — the core swap value is missing
'Testnet' chip inside the token selector is easy to read as the token network but the top toggle says 'Same network' — confusing
fixes: Replace MARKET_WIRE_JSON_REQUIRED with human copy ('Book unavailable — waiting for hub feed') and a retry action
Show mid price, spread and estimated receive amount plus fee before submit
Disable Swap until a quote exists; show why it is disabled

top_issues: No financial state shown: no credit line, collateral, balance or exposure numbers — 'Frames signed 0' is the only metric and it means nothing to users
Only the footnote explains credit vs collateral; the numbers it describes are absent
Action grid is unbalanced (Pay, Extend credit, Swap / Manage alone), leaving a hole in the layout
Counterparty 'Hub' and Network 'Testnet' rows are near-constant filler
fixes: Add an exposure summary: credit line, collateral, secured/at-risk split with the standard scale bars
Add inbound/outbound capacity rows; drop or merge constant rows

top_issues: '1 movements' — grammar bug in the header

Filter pills (Payments/Swaps/Settlement/Accounts) imply volume the empty account cannot show

Rephrase provenance line: 'Signed and verifiable — export proof'

top_issues: Detail panel duplicates the list row exactly — no hashes, signatures, or export affordance for a 'created' event
'Frame #7' is raw internals without a link to the frame or explanation
Identical to 07-activity.png; if a distinct detail view was intended it is missing
Green provenance line again uses 'runtime's committed frames' jargon

Differentiate selected-row detail from the list

top_issues: Very long single column; RUNTIME and VAULT blocks sit far below the fold with no section nav

Dollars-per-pixel scale concept is well explained but the 'AT THIS SCALE' example overlaps the left column visually at this width

Move 'Forget vault' to a separate danger zone with typed confirmation
Show live mini-previews for accent and risk-color choices

top_issues: All six source/target cards show 0.00 USDC — the user cannot see why '250' fails beyond the red line 'Amount exceeds what is available here'
Error appears below the buttons with no field highlighting; buttons remain ambiguous gray
'Recipient entity · leave empty for yourself' with raw 0x… placeholder is developer vocabulary
The 'WHAT HAPPENS' explainer is good but shows only one step ('Fund you through H1') with an empty radio circle
fixes: Show available max per card and pre-validate the amount field with inline red border
Replace 'entity id' placeholder with 'Their wallet address (optional)'
Disable Sign & send with a reason until the form is valid

top_issues: Six feature doors with one-line descriptions but no state data (balances, alerts) — a launcher where a console was expected
'0 lanes · 0 frames · open' in the accounts card is unexplained jargon ('lanes')
'NEEDS ATTENTION — Nothing waiting on you' is fine but occupies prime space doing nothing
Two adjacent rail icons map to Manage/Desk ambiguously; Manage itself links to five sub-screens not shown

Rename 'lanes' or add a tooltip; collapse empty NEEDS ATTENTION

top_issues: All balances 0.00 with 'Depository may pull 0.00' repeated three times — the allowance phrase is unexplained and alarming
Faucet buttons are four heavy indigo fills stacked — visual weight suggests four equal primary actions
'Move into reserve' button icon (arrow) with label below is low-contrast and cramped
Debts explainer is good copy but detached from any number
fixes: Explain allowance inline ('what the Depository contract can move without asking')
Restyle faucet actions as a list with a single 'Get test funds' primary
Show debts as a row with amount, always present

top_issues: No APY/rate market context: user sets basis points (100 = 1.00%/term) with zero reference to what the pool pays or what others ask
H1 POOL shows Available/Borrowed/Active principal all 0.00 — no reason to lend here
'0 lanes' again unexplained; Hub selector duplicates the only hub
Term buttons uneven widths (1 hour / 1 day / 1 month) look unintentional
fixes: Show projected interest for the chosen amount/term next to the input
Equalize term buttons; explain lanes or drop the term
Add pool utilization and history once nonzero

top_issues: 'Kind: Lazy (hash of its board)' and 'Register it on the EntityProvider' are pure protocol internals — meaningless to any of the ten users
No shares, members, or board table shown; the screen promises 'Board, shares, takeovers' and delivers four rows
'TAKE CONTROL OF ANOTHER ENTITY' reads menacing as a headline for a standard governance action
Whole screen is nearly empty; no actions available
fixes: Rewrite kind as 'Single signer' vs 'Multi-signer (m of n)'; move 'lazy/hash' detail behind an advanced disclosure
Rename takeover card to 'Add an entity you sign for'

top_issues: Best trust screen, but all figures are $0.00/0 of 1 so the enforceability story is unproven
'awaiting their signature · no proof yet · they answer in 1d, you in 1d' is a dense run-on in the counterparty card
'Can dispute without asking 0 of 1' needs one clarifying line about what asking means
'Save evidence bundle' is exactly right for Kenji/Ravi but appears before any money exists — no example of its output
fixes: Break the counterparty status into stacked lines with icons and countdown
Add a tooltip linking 'dispute without asking' to the challenge-window doc

top_issues: Table header truncated ('FR…' cut at right edge) and the book card overlaps the table's right column — data is clipped, worst legibility failure in the set
Seven color-coded columns (Position/Secured/At Risk/You Owe/Send·Receive/Lines) plus a seven-item legend strip, all $0.00 — dense without data
'Reserve · on-chain' row mixes two layers in one label while the columns above assume accounts
'MARKET_WIRE_JSON_REQUIRED' leaks here too
fixes: Fit the table to its container or allow horizontal scroll with a visible affordance; never truncate the last header
Show the legend as column tooltips instead of a color strip
Fix the book error string as on 05-swap

top_issues: Command palette is clean, but descriptions like 'batch, attention, doors' are cryptic
No keyboard hint per item (only ⌘K in the input) and no recent/frequent grouping
'keys, proofs, exposure' jargon will not help Maya or Fatima
Overlay dims content that includes the same clipped table problem from 16-desk behind it
fixes: Write task-outcome descriptions ('See what is enforceable on-chain', 'Move money between layers')
Add a Recents section and per-item shortcut hints

overall.verdict: A visually disciplined dark fintech UI with one coherent idea (absolute-scale bars, layered money) that is consistently applied — but every screen is shown empty, internal protocol strings leak into user surfaces, and the flagship value (instant provable payments) is never demonstrated. It reads as an excellent developer console wearing a consumer wallet's clothes.
priority_fixes: Eliminate all raw error/internal strings shown to users (MARKET_WIRE_JSON_REQUIRED on 05-swap and 16-desk; 'lazy hash of its board' on 14-ownership; 'lanes', 'frames', 'runtime's committed frames') — single biggest trust kill
Fix the 16-desk table clipping/truncation so no header or column is ever cut off
Fill the empty state: first-run checklist on Home (get funds → open account → pay) and demo/live data so zero-value screens stop dominating
Show derived financial figures wherever a task needs them: swap quote + fee (05), credit/collateral exposure on account (06), projected interest on lending (13), available-max validation on Move (10)
Safety hygiene on Settings: separate destructive 'Forget vault' with confirmation, and fix the '1 movements' pluralization
